caption: At the 2,000 req/s peak, 18 servers are needed; elastic runs 1 server for the other 20 h and 18 for the 4 h peak, while fixed runs 18 all day. Over 30 days the elastic bill is ₹16,560 against ₹77,760 fixed, saving ₹61,200.

spec.aria: A one-day schedule: the elastic lane runs 1 server for 20 hours and 18 servers for the 4-hour peak, while the fixed lane runs 18 servers for all 24 hours.
